introHtml: Two tone buttons, stickers, and patches add visual depth that single-color designs cannot match. By combining two contrasting hues, your logo or message stands out on lapels, hard hats, or laptop lids. Marketing directors use them for event giveaways that pop, while safety managers rely on two tone patches to color-code team roles. Choose from matte or gloss finishes and standard adhesive or magnetic backs for buttons. The dual-color effect works especially well with spot-color printing on stickers or embroidered patches, giving your branding a professional edge without increasing complexity.
